raw:
Agent Name: Corporate_Governance_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Corporate_Governance_Expert made an oversight in the initial step by concluding that further investigation was required to determine which member of Apple's Board of Directors did not hold C-suite positions when the detailed professional histories already confirmed that all listed members had held C-suite positions prior to joining the board. This unnecessary continuation of the investigation led to redundant work and a failure to directly resolve the task at hand.
